section_summary.extract_value: This section details the procedure for a single study, where participants underwent a 90-minute session. During this session, they were administered a divergent thinking test (ATTA), the Creative Achievement Questionnaire, and an oddball task with continuous EEG recording. Following the EEG session, participants were also given the Wechsler Abbreviated Scale of Intelligence.
